method: Official full-page PDF text opened with web tool; relevant regulations sections read, not a complete visual review of all 27 pages.

Sections 2 and 7 require independent scientific work, an original coherent scientific contribution, dissertation and oral examination. Section 1(4) requires school criteria for selecting the particular degree; section 9 assigns actual degree determination to the responsible school.
